title: 24 Percent Efficient n-Type Silicon Solar Cell
authors: Fraunhofer Institute for Solar Energy Systems ISE

passages.locator: pp. 1–2, description of the cell and research support
passages.note: Fraunhofer ISE in Freiburg reported 24% conversion efficiency for an n-type silicon cell with a full-area rear passivating contact. The tunnel oxide/silicon stack let majority carriers through while suppressing recombination. The institute compared it with partial-area contacts and identified German Federal Ministry for the Environment, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety support.

file.representation: paraphrased research notes and selected factual observations
